title: NO DICTATORS - Oslo, Norway

location.venue: Frogner Park - Meet at Lincoln monument

description:
Please join Democrats Abroad Norway members and others in Oslo on Saturday, June 14 in a global day of defiance and solidarity against authoritarianism.

We’ll be gathering at the Abraham Lincoln monument in Frogner Park from noon to 2pm (12:00-14:00) LOCAL TIME (GMT+2) for silent as well as vocal protest. We’re calling it No Dictators Day – our counter-birthday party for Donald Trump, in conjunction with hundreds of similar events in the U.S. and around the world. Bring your friends and family, and above all bring your enthusiasm, your voice (since there will be singing) and your matpakke (since it will be lunchtime).

We’ll celebrate the eloquence and achievements of perhaps our greatest president in comparison to the failures and absurdities of a self-congratulatory would-be monarch who fawns over his own birthday with an unnecessary and ridiculously expensive military parade. Americans revere our 16th president as much for the lofty, hopeful rhetoric of what he wrote and said, as for his signal accomplishments: the preservation of the Union and his more prosaic yet powerful proclamation that slaves shall henceforth be free.

But Lincoln could never have predicted our 45th and 47th president’s lust for power and his acolytes in Congress’ kowtowing to his every whim.

It’s up to us to listen to Abe on Flag Day, to appeal to the better angels of our nature and to help stop the wickedness and folly.

Note that because Norway DOES have a king, we are calling our event "No Dictators." Please do not bring signs with "no kings" language out of respect to Norway. The image is set by No Kings and cannot be changed.

*A core principle behind all No Kings events is a commitment to nonviolent action. We expect all participants to seek to de-escalate any potential confrontation with those who disagree with our values.*

description:
**In America, the government doesn’t get to grab people off the streets, skip the courtroom, and send them straight to a foreign prison.** Disappeared in America is a national day of action to stand up for the rule of law and confront the Trump administration’s illegal abductions, detentions, and deportations of people like Kilmar Abrego Garcia, Rui Marras, and Juan Maldonado Zuniga.

Americans believe in rule of law —and the courts are saying that due process is required. If a president can ignore the courts and disappear lawful residents, there is no limit to what can come next. President Trump has said he wants to abduct and deport U.S. citizens. If this isn’t stopped now, no one is safe.

Sheriffs have wide discretion in how much they cooperate with ICE. Participation in federal immigration activities places additional burden on sheriffs’ offices and can erode local community trust in local law enforcement.

title: Triangle Bridges to Freedom

location.venue: Bridge addresses will vary across the Triangle

description:
On July 6th from 4pm-6pm, we will have a coordinated bridge brigade that covers all of the bridges in the Triangle to show our love for our country and our fight to protect our freedom. As we celebrate our Independence Day, we want to have a huge Visibility Brigade event where drivers see our message "Protect Freedom" as they drive under every overpass in Durham, Raleigh, Chapel Hill, Cary, and beyond. 

More details to follow. You can learn these details by visiting our website.

https://docs.google.com/document/d/1jSwNQ0Cmu1FZziGAGK-PE5GgPW8d4mPfIpLY8Bflj1k/edit?usp=sharing

Each bridge will have the same message: "Protect Freedom" We will ask people to bring American flags.

We will not make people sign up for a specific bridge ahead of time.

Please tell your friends to come. We want a big showing to reclaim our flag, reclaim our country, and celebrate our independence and our freedom!

title: 50501SWLA Resistance Gathering-- a pro-democracy solidarity event

location.venue: Edwin F. Hunter, Jr. U.S. Courthouse

description:
On the first Saturday each month, 50501SWLA hosts what we call a "Resistance Gathering".  This is a solidarity event where we offer safety, support, and peaceful actions steps we plan and can do together.  

At each gathering we have music, an art table with supplies to make your own poster if you choose to, and we enjoy loads of fun.  Music, singing, dancing, cheering, cracking jokes, sharing niceties (like stickers and buttons, for example), and networking with local stakeholder leaders.  

This gives us the opportunity to meet consistently, build relationships, strengthen networking ties, discuss and strategize ideas and plans together, and so much more. 

We'll have water there.  Please bring a lawn chair if you'd like to rest you feet and sit for a while.  Hats are suggested due to the sun.  Bringing a healthy snack is a good idea too. 

The more, the merrier.  Don't be shy.  We need you :)

title: Call Voters In Virginia To Win in November 2025
description:
### Join Swing Left Peninsula and our partner the Bay Area Coalition ###

Join our phone bank, to make calls to voters in Virginia for the November 4, 2025 state government election. 

**Virginians will be electing a new Governor,** Lt. Governor, Secretary of State and Attorney General along with all 100 seats in the House Of Delegates.

Our experienced coaches will be on hand to help callers access the calls, get familiar with the candidates and VA voting details, review scripts for the calls and guide callers throughout the phone bank.

A few things to keep in mind when you attend this phone bank:
- Don’t worry if you’ve never done something like this before. We’ll provide a phone script and a list of voters to call.
- You’ll need a phone and a laptop computer or tablet to make calls.

If you have questions about this event, please RSVP and respond to confirmation email you receive to reach out to the host.

*By signing up for this event you are giving permission to be added to the Swing Left Peninsula email list. Our emails share timely, impactful actions (letter parties, phone banks, canvasses, and voter registrations) for strategic, toss-up races that will help us retain the Presidency and Senate, win back the House, and secure important state-level offices and ballot measures. Every email we send includes an unsubscribe link. If you don't want to be on our list, we want you to unsubscribe! (Please don't mark this email as spam, or we will have trouble reaching the people who DO want to hear from us.) You won't be resubscribed by us.*
